items.description: The A2A x402 Extension brings cryptocurrency payments to the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, enabling agents to monetize their services through on-chain payments. This extension revives the spirit of HTTP 402 "Payment Required" for the decentralized agent ecosystem.
items.intro: A2A x402扩展将加密货币支付引入代理间（A2A）协议，使代理能够通过链上支付实现其服务的货币化。此扩展重现了HTTP 402“付款请求”的精神。
